Question: What are some amazing facts about the Indian Railways?
Answer: 1.The resonance frequency of the suspension for the coaches is kept as close as possible to 72 bpm or 1.2 Hz while designing which is optimal for sleep and relaxation. 2.The diamond crossing (dubbed so by railways themselves), in Nagpur, is one-of-its-kind, from where trains go East, West, North and South. 3.The Indian Railways is the 8th largest employer in the world with 14 lakh employees. 4.The IRCTC website is the second most visited website in India. 5.The under-construction Chenab railway bridge, in Reasi district, J&K, is expected to be one of the highest rail bridges in the world, when completed. 6.The famed Darjeeling "toy train," which is still running on its indigenous steam engine, was built by India's British colonial master in 1881. 7.The track length of Indian Railways can circle the equator one and a half times. 8.Shrirampur and Belapur are two different stations in Maharashtra's Ahmednagar district, at the same location on the railway route but on opposite sides of the track. 9.Indian Railways runs as many as 19,000 trains every day. Some 12,000 trains are for passengers and 7,000 for freight. 10.The railway station of Navapur is built in 2 states; one half of it is in Maharashtra and the other half is in Gujarat. And another station named Bhawani Mandi is also divided into two states Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh. 11.Indian Railways did not have a toilet for 50 years until one passenger wrote an angry letter to Indian Railways.

Question: What is your review on Panchayat 2?
Answer: Panchayat - Another masterpiece by TVF Panchayat 1 attracted its viewers by showing how Jeetu bhaiya just wanted to get out of the village but didn't succeed. Panchayat 2 continued with the same struggle but now he got more engrossed in that life and started to enjoy that life. The series showed the friendship bond between Pradhanji, Prahlad Chacha, Vikas and Sachivji. As seen in Part 1, Sachivji faced difficulties when siding himself with Pradhanji but Pradhanji would give Louki☺️ to him as a mark of friendship. So, a dialogue that hit hard in season 2 where Sachivji says “Pradhanji dost keh dene se kuch nahi hota, dosti nibhani bhi aani chahiye.” That scene taught how you expect a person to stand for you but when it's your turn, you should also be there for them. You would see new characters as well as old and how their innocence and natural acting would make you laugh. As in the previous season, a social issue - Population Control was explained in a funny manner, this season they targeted how homes in India may not have a toilet and some homes even after having it, the people go to farms as that has become their habit. You would be amazed by this man's acting. There is a scene where a person's Goat gets lost,so as cameras are installed in the village he asks Sachivji to show him the footage, Sachivji says no as he says “Inn sab cheezon ke liye thodi lagvaya hai” to which the man says that the Goat's milk is their source of income and that tells how a thing may seem to be not important for a person but for the other, it would mean their world. The episodes are short - 35 to 40 minutes each. So, binge watching it would relieve you of your stress and make you laugh and enjoy. The series is a must watch and it will make you forget of everything around and give you a nice and wonderful experience.
